RMM evaluation and operations templates.

Turn CVE remediation, patch compliance reporting, Windows Update evidence, endpoint exceptions, network-monitoring acceptance, RMM evaluation, service desk escalation, troubleshooting, recovery, QBRs, security evidence, client lifecycle work, migrations, incidents, and tabletop exercises into owned, reviewable records. More than fifty templates are plain CSV files—no account, email address, or product installation required.
